gap_records.summary: Required candidate file for `native_godot_project` is unverified.

acceptance_requirements: Preserve the full frozen R02 requirement: movement, jump, sprint, dodge, automatic stepping and camera must work; facing, hand/back equipment and shoulder switching must be correct.
This iteration establishes only fresh unarmed idle-to-walk behavior. Its two completion conditions do not independently close R02 or milestone_01.
Acceptance requires ordinary-input, candidate-bound runtime observations and independent Tester review; source inspection and imported assets are supporting evidence.
deferred_items: Remaining R02 coverage, including jump/landing, sprint, dodge/roll, automatic stepping, shoulder switching and earned equipment mounts, remains mandatory; preserve existing behavior and report its current verification status.
gap:native_godot_project, gap:host_godot_boot and gap:milestone_01_review remain mandatory backlog and do not receive separate tasks or implementation targets this iteration.
Implement the MAP01 Isa dialogue module after the selected locomotion foundation is verified, following the bound operator-development instruction.
Equipment acquisition, combat, progression, saves, later chapters and presentation expansion remain outside this bounded increment.
implied_completion: Configure the unarmed opening before actor initialization can expose an equipped pose or weapon.
Use the candidate's actual imported animation catalog and advancing playback, together with visible limb motion, to establish idle and locomotion.
Keep the complete Ranger head, selected authored terrain/collision, original art dependencies, licenses and provenance intact.
mandatory_objectives: Deliver one small player-visible increment under milestone_01 R02: grounded unarmed idle, walking and return to idle on the existing authored village.
Preserve the selected village controller's existing traversal, camera and weapon-binding mechanisms through a bounded product adaptation.
Provide candidate-owned inputs needed for independent ordinary-input review without fabricating runtime acceptance.
task_specification.objective: Make Aelor's fresh unarmed idle-to-walk transition usable on the existing authored village terrain, using the selected complete Ranger and animation bindings, while keeping full R02 acceptance pending until independently demonstrated.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate contains the selected intact village-demo sources and key map, Ranger, base-head, animation and weapon dependencies. Its startup logic still implements the demo's equipped state: weapon_mode defaults to sword, _ready requests Sword_Idle, weapon visibility is not gated by possession, and input permits sword/bow selection. This conflicts with the PRD's unarmed opening and creates a concrete adaptation need before verifying locomotion in that opening state. Import success, rendered quality and ordinary-input behavior remain unverified; no current runtime defect verdict or missing Host operation has been established.

stop_conditions: Stop expanding this increment after its two completion conditions and focused preservation checks are demonstrated.
If a selected dependency cannot load, report its exact candidate-relative path and observed error; retain the baseline and do not substitute placeholder terrain or actors.

If Host input, scene inspection or frame capture is unavailable, report insufficient evidence and the missing operation separately from product behavior. Do not assign Host collector repairs to candidate files.
Do not claim R02 or milestone_01 passes unless the complete frozen requirement receives the required current-run independent verdict.

strategy.rationale: The operator-selected baseline is already present and its source bindings are inspectable. Adapt the concrete equipped-start mismatch and verify one small locomotion transition before adding story or combat. Reusing these bindings respects the two-condition budget and avoids unnecessary resource replacement.

code: Check the scoped startup, equipment visibility, selection and attack paths against the unarmed precondition; preserve existing map, rig, clip and mount dependencies.
Use the registered engine import/load checks and inspect errors. File presence alone does not establish dependency closure or runtime compatibility.
Validate any candidate-owned journey against the registered Host schema and discovered runtime paths; keep it isolated from normal startup.
runtime: Host and Tester own replay and recapture. Establish a baseline through ordinary input, then repeat fresh launch, neutral idle, WASD walking, release and return to idle on the changed candidate.
Negative check: from the fresh unarmed state press weapon-selection and attack inputs; observe that no unearned weapon or equipped action appears.

State/frame matrix: fresh settled idle; walking forward; reversed input direction; walking after changing camera yaw; stopped idle. Sample actual animation playback and actor transforms where the registered observation interface permits.

Perform adjacent preservation checks for existing jump/landing, sprint, dodge/roll, step/wall contact, camera collision and shoulder changes; distinguish passed, failed and unmeasured behavior without expanding implementation scope automatically.
visual: Inspect separated front/side/back idle and moving views for a complete face, eyes, hood, coherent proportions, visible limb motion, ground contact and absence of unearned hand/back weapons.

Compare the ordinary product camera with the supplied hero/village references for actor readability and material coherence. Keep this comparison within the reused baseline; do not add unrelated presentation work.
Verify the actual authored village remains visible and supports walking, without appended graybox slabs, walls, pillars or substitute actor visuals.

done_when: A fresh product launch settles the complete Ranger on authored village ground in visibly breathing neutral idle, with no sword or bow visible in either hand or on the back; ordinary weapon-selection and attack inputs cannot expose unearned equipment.

From that unarmed idle, ordinary WASD input moves the Ranger camera-relatively along a short verified village-ground route with visible walking limb motion and matching model facing; releasing input stops travel and returns to neutral breathing idle.
tasks.instructions: Anchor this increment to PRD 3.2 and R02, with the unarmed opening as its existing PRD precondition. Read the candidate's player_controller.gd initialization, input, visibility and animation functions; preview_controller.gd scene/spawn binding; Player.tscn; and the relevant traversal_controller.gd idle/locomotion implementation. Reuse the existing Preview-to-authored-village and Player-to-Ranger/base-head/UAL/KayKit bindings. Adapt only the product startup and ownership behavior necessary for this slice, through clear interfaces and bounded changes; preserve the selected controller rather than replacing it. Establish unarmed configuration before actor tree entry, gate equipment visibility and selection by actual ownership, and prevent unarmed attack input from invoking an equipped action. This does not authorize an acquisition quest or combat system. Query the actual imported animation catalog and verify neutral idle and walking playback; do not infer successful playback from requested labels or raw GLB names. Check the combined model transforms rather than introducing a universal facing correction. Confirm the existing spawn raycast finds real supporting terrain; repair a demonstrated spawn failure within the current wrapper rather than adding a substitute floor or fixed-height recovery. Use a short route selected from the actual reachable village, recording its starting point and endpoint for reproduction. Preserve other existing traversal and camera behavior and report failures without broadening this task. Supply a bounded candidate-owned journey for the two completion conditions if the registered Host journey interface supports it: physical inputs, discovered exact runtime node paths, authoritative scalar observations and representative frames; no pass flags, direct state-changing self-drives or startup test automation. Retain source licenses and existing staging provenance. Resource families: village_authored_environment is the operator-selected complete textured authored scene, a justified semantic_single!

Relevant current code and the collection manifest were inspected. risk_note.summary: Animation requests and imported file presence may look correct while the rendered actor is static, incomplete or unsupported by terrain.
risk_note.validation: Pair external ordinary WASD actions and separated idle/walk/stop frames with actual animation key, playing status, advancing playback position, actor displacement and supporting-ground observations. Report unavailable observations as insufficient evidence.
risk_note.why_now: There is no current-run runtime verdict, and the fresh opening changes the demo's initial equipment and pose state.
